notes: Hunt crash fix: since 3.9.6 the hunt server could crash on your first hit, so hits did no damage and the hunt ended. The game mod asked the game for the behemoth's display name at that moment, and the game crashed inside UE4SS; it no longer asks. Behemoth names still come from the game's own row names, kill tokens and item texts. Close the game fully and start it again after updating.
